**priya_enth** 09:05

**aisha_ops** 09:10

---

## **Friday 10 Jan 2025**

Digital Literacy Program pilot_end_date 2024-08-30 date. Record status: historical.

**priya_enth** 11:30
Quick question – for the final evaluation, should we include a section on what participants want to learn next? I think it'd help shape future programs.

**marcus_dev** 11:35
Good idea. Maybe also ask about preferred session times – some of the working folks might prefer evenings.

**aisha_ops** 11:40
Yes, both good. I'll add those to the draft. I'll share it with you both by Wed.

---

## **Monday 13 Jan 2025**

**aisha_ops** 15:00
Just a reminder – YAG meeting this Wed 15 Jan at 4pm. Same place. Marcus, can you bring the community centre booking confirmation for the outdoor movie?

**marcus_dev** 15:05
Yep, will do.

**priya_enth** 15:10
I'll bring the summer program notes – the teens might want to see the full list again. Also, I'll confirm the artist for the workshop – she said she'd send a bio for the flyer.

---

## **Wednesday 15 Jan 2025**

**aisha_ops** 16:30
YAG meeting done! Good turnout – 8 teens. Key points:
- Outdoor movie confirmed – Sat 25 Jan, 7pm start
- Art workshop – Sat 15 Feb, 2pm
- Cooking class – Sun 9 Feb, 11am
- Photography walk – we'll do it in Mar (need to pick a date)
- The teens want to help promote the events – they'll make posters

**priya_enth** 16:35
They're so keen! I'll send them the poster templates. Also – I'll follow up with the 2 schools we mentioned in Dec. I'll email them this week.

**marcus_dev** 16:40
I'll add the photography walk to the events calendar for Mar – I'll put a placeholder for now.

---

## **Friday 17 Jan 2025**

**marcus_dev** 10:00
Digital literacy session 10 done – 11 participants. We covered online forms & applications. A few folks struggled with the government services portal – might be worth doing a dedicated session on that in the future.

**aisha_ops** 10:05
Noted. I'll add it to the future program ideas list. Also – the survey draft is ready. I've shared it in the drive – folder "Digital Literacy/2025/evaluation". Please have a look and let me know your thoughts by Mon.
## **Monday 20 Jan 2025**

**aisha_ops** 09:15
Morning all – quick update. The survey draft is in the drive as promised. pls have a look by Wed so we can finalise before the end of the month. Link is in the folder "Digital Literacy/2025/evaluation".

**marcus_dev** 09:30
Had a quick look – looks good. One suggestion: maybe separate the "preferred session times" into weekday vs weekend rather than just evening/morning. Some folks might have different availability.

**priya_enth** 09:35
Good point. Also, for the "what to learn next" section – could we add an option for "job applications & resumes"? I've had a few people ask about that recently.

**aisha_ops** 09:40
Yep, will do. I'll update the draft tonight and share the revised version.

---

**marcus_dev** 11:00
FYI – I've booked the community room for the photography walk. Provisional date is Sat 15 Mar, 10am. I'll confirm with the venue by end of week.

**aisha_ops** 11:05
Great. I'll add it to the events calendar once confirmed.

**priya_enth** 11:10
Perfect – I'll let the teens know at the next YAG meeting. They were keen to help with promotion.

---

## **Wednesday 22 Jan 2025**

**aisha_ops** 14:00
Morning all – reminder that the outdoor movie is this Sat 25 Jan at 7pm. We need volunteers for setup from 5pm. Can I get a show of hands?

**marcus_dev** 14:05
I can do setup and stay for the first hour.

**priya_enth** 14:10
I'll be there from 5pm too, and can help with the popcorn station.

**aisha_ops** 14:15
Thanks both. I'll bring the projector and screen – Marcus, can you grab the extension cords from the storeroom?

**marcus_dev** 14:20
Yep, will do.

---

**priya_enth** 15:00
Update on the schools – I emailed both this morning. One has replied already (Northside High) – they're keen to promote the art workshop to their students. The other (Westfield Primary) hasn't replied yet – I'll follow up next week.

**aisha_ops** 15:05
Great work. Let me know if you need any flyers or posters for them.

---

## **Friday 24 Jan 2025**

**marcus_dev** 09:00
Digital literacy session 11 done – 9 participants. We covered online forms again, plus a bit on troubleshooting common issues. A few people asked about setting up email accounts – might be worth a session on that.

**aisha_ops** 09:05
Noted. I'll add it to the ideas list.

**priya_enth** 09:10
Quick question – do we have any spare laptops for the art workshop? The artist said she might need one for a demo.

**marcus_dev** 09:15
We have 2 in the storeroom – I'll check they're charged and working before the event.

**aisha_ops** 09:20
Thanks. Can you also put a note on the booking calendar so we know they're in use?

---

## **Saturday 25 Jan 2025**

**aisha_ops** 19:30
Outdoor movie is on! Great turnout – about 40 people. Thanks to everyone who helped with setup. The teens did a fantastic job with the posters – they're up around the neighbourhood now.

**marcus_dev** 19:35
Was a great night. The projector worked well – no issues. I'll pack up the equipment and return it to the storeroom tomorrow.

**priya_enth** 19:40
Agreed – the crowd loved it. I took some photos for the library's social media – I'll share them with you both for approval before posting.

---

## **Monday 27 Jan 2025**

**aisha_ops** 10:00
Hope everyone had a good weekend. Quick update – the survey is now live! I've shared the link on the library's website and social media. We'll keep it open until Fri 14 Feb.

**marcus_dev** 10:05
Great. I'll mention it in the next digital literacy session.

**priya_enth** 10:10
I'll share it with the schools too – they might be able to circulate it to parents.

---

**aisha_ops** 11:30
Also – I've added the photography walk to the events calendar as provisional (Sat 15 Mar, 10am). Marcus, can you confirm the booking with the community centre this week?

**marcus_dev** 11:35
Yep, will do. I'll call them tmrw.

---

## **Wednesday 29 Jan 2025**

**priya_enth** 09:00
Morning! The artist for the art workshop sent her bio – I've uploaded it to the drive under "Art Workshop/2025". The flyer is looking great – I've shared a draft in the same folder for feedback.
## **Thursday 30 Jan 2025**

**aisha_ops** 08:45
Morning all. Just a heads up – the annual report draft is due to council by end of Feb. I'll be pulling together the programming stats this week. Can everyone send me their session numbers and attendance figures by Fri?

**marcus_dev** 08:50
Will do. I've got the digital literacy numbers ready – just need to tally the drop-in sessions.

**priya_enth** 08:55
Same here – I'll compile the children's and teen program stats today. Also, I noticed the draft flyer for the art workshop has a typo in the date – it says Sat 15 Mar but the calendar says Sat 22 Mar. Should I fix it?

**aisha_ops** 09:00
Good catch – yes, please fix it. The event is definitely Sat 22 Mar.

---

**aisha_ops** 10:15
Also, we need to update the programming policy before the next team meeting. Council has asked for a review of our cancellation and waitlist procedures. I'll draft the changes and share them here for comment.

**marcus_dev** 10:20
Happy to review. I've got some thoughts on the waitlist process from the last few months.

**priya_enth** 10:25
Me too – especially for school holiday programs. The waitlists filled up fast over summer.

---

## **Friday 31 Jan 2025**

**priya_enth** 09:30
Morning! I've shared the updated art workshop flyer in the drive – date fixed. The artist has also confirmed she'll need a projector for her demo, not just a laptop. Can we arrange that?

**marcus_dev** 09:35
No worries – we've got a portable projector in the AV cabinet. I'll test it before the event.

**aisha_ops** 09:40
Perfect. Can you also book the community room for the workshop? I know it's usually free on Saturdays but let's be sure.

**marcus_dev** 09:45
Will do – I'll call the bookings officer tmrw.

---

**aisha_ops** 14:00
Quick update – the survey response is looking good so far. 87 responses in the first week. Keep sharing the link, especially with anyone who might not have seen it online.

**priya_enth** 14:05
Great news! I'll send another reminder to the school contacts today.

**marcus_dev** 14:10
I mentioned it at the digital literacy session this morning – a few people took a photo of the QR code.

---

## **Monday 3 Feb 2025**

**aisha_ops** 09:00
Morning all. Hope you had a good weekend. A few things for this week:

- The photography walk is still provisional – Marcus, any news from the community centre?
- The art workshop is confirmed for Sat 22 Mar – flyer is being printed this week.
- Annual report stats – please have your numbers to me by Fri.

**marcus_dev** 09:10
I called the community centre on Friday – they've confirmed the booking for Sat 15 Mar, 10am. I'll update the events calendar to confirmed.

**aisha_ops** 09:15
Thanks! That's one less thing to worry about.

**priya_enth** 09:20
I'll add the photography walk to the library's social media calendar – I'll schedule a post for early March.

---

**marcus_dev** 11:00
Just a reminder – I'll be out of the office Thu and Fri this week for training. I'll have my phone on me if anything urgent comes up.

**aisha_ops** 11:05
Noted. Hope it goes well – is it the new cataloguing system training?

**marcus_dev** 11:10
Yep, the vendor is running a two-day session. Should be useful for the next upgrade.

**priya_enth** 11:15
Sounds good – let us know if you learn anything about the new interface!

---

## **Wednesday 5 Feb 2025**

**priya_enth** 10:30
Morning! I've finished compiling the children's and teen program stats for the annual report. I'll send them to Aisha by end of day.

**aisha_ops** 10:35
Thanks Priya – that's a big help.

**marcus_dev** 10:40
I'm just finishing the digital literacy numbers now – will send them over this afternoon.

---

**aisha_ops** 13:00
I've shared a draft of the programming policy update in the drive – it's under "Policy/2025/Draft". Please have a look and add comments by next Wed. Key changes are around cancellation procedures and how we handle waitlists.

**marcus_dev** 13:10
Just had a quick look – looks good. One thing I'd suggest: clarifying what happens if a program is cancelled due to low numbers and whether we offer a priority spot for the next session.

Great work. Can you order the replacement battery pack and the motor? I'll approve the request.

---

## **Friday 5 Jan 2024**

**marcus_dev** 09:00
Last call for Q1 program ideas! I'm locking the calendar today. Anyone who hasn't sent through their suggestions, get them in by 5pm.

**aisha_ops** 09:05
I've got one - what about a parent-child coding workshop for the younger kids? Like 6-8 age group. We could use the Scratch Jr app on the library iPads.

Good idea. I'll add it to the list. Can you check how many iPads we have that are functional? I know some of them have had charging issues.

**aisha_ops** 09:12
Will do. I'll do a full check on Monday.

**jordan_tech** 09:15
Also - I found the projector remote. It was in the staff kitchen. No idea how it got there but we're good for Thursday.

**marcus_dev** 09:16
Classic. Thanks for chasing it.

**priya_enth** 09:20
Should we do a social media push for the STEM series? I can draft some posts if you want. Get the word out early.

**marcus_dev** 09:22
Let's hold off until we've confirmed the dates and room bookings. Don't want to promote something that might change. I'll let you know once it's locked.

**priya_enth** 09:23

---

## **Monday 8 Jan 2024**

**marcus_dev** 08:45
Morning all. Q1 calendar is now locked. I'll post the full schedule here shortly. Key dates to note:
- **Summer Reading Challenge** - running through Jan, final celebration event on 27 Jan
- **Code Club** - weekly on Thursdays from this week
- **STEM Workshop Series** - starting early Feb, more details to come

---

## **Tuesday 9 Jan 2024**

**aisha_ops** 10:15

Good to know. Can you order the replacement cables? And maybe flag the cracked ones for replacement in the next budget cycle.

---

Draft social media posts are ready for the STEM series. I've got 3 versions – one for Facebook, one for Instagram, one for the library newsletter. Can someone review before I schedule them?

I'll take a look this arvo. Quick question – have we confirmed the exact dates and times for all 6 sessions?

---

## **Thursday 11 Jan 2024**

**marcus_dev** 09:00

**priya_enth** 09:05
Excellent! Scheduling now. First post goes out tomorrow.

**jordan_tech** 09:15

**marcus_dev** 09:20
Thanks. If it's not back in time, we can swap the 3D printing session with the robotics one. I'll note that as a contingency.

**aisha_ops** 09:25

---

## **Monday 15 Jan 2024**

**aisha_ops** 09:30
Quick check on numbers – how many registrations do we have for the STEM series so far? I know it's early but just want to see if we need to promote more.

**priya_enth** 09:35
Just checked – 14 registered. We have capacity for 20. The social posts went out on Friday and Saturday, so hopefully numbers pick up this week.

**marcus_dev** 09:40
Good. Can you look at the age breakdown? I want to make sure we're getting a good spread across the range.

**priya_enth** 09:42
From what I can see – 5 in the 8-10 bracket, 6 in the 11-12 bracket, 3 in the 13-14 bracket. Not bad but the older kids are underrepresented. I might adjust the messaging to appeal more to that group.

**marcus_dev** 09:45
Sounds good. Maybe highlight the robotics and coding aspects – that tends to pull in the older ones.

**jordan_tech** 09:50
On that note – I'm finalising the session plans. For the robotics session I'm thinking we use the LEGO Mindstorms kits. We have 6 kits, so pairs of kids per kit. That works for up to 12 kids per session. If we get more than that registered, we might need to run two groups.

Roster draft is up in the shared drive – "School Holidays Volunteer Roster" folder. Please check your shifts and let me know if there's any conflicts. I've tried to keep everyone to their usual days but there's a couple of changes.

Thanks. Just had a look – I'm good with mine. One thing though, can we add a note about who's bringing the craft supplies for the holiday program? I don't want that to get forgotten.

Yes, same day. Code Club frequency weekly – that doesn't change over the holidays. The only change is the room, since the community room is booked for another event on one of the days. I'll double check and let you know.

I think it's the second week of April that's affected. I'll confirm with the bookings team.

---

## **Monday 26 Feb 2024**

**jordan_tech** 10:10
Update on the filament – it arrived this morning. I've put it in the storage cupboard with the other supplies. Also – I've noticed the Code Club laptops are running a bit slow. Might be worth doing a cleanup before the next session.

Thanks. Can you sort that out? Maybe do it on the weekend when the library's quieter. I don't want to interrupt the weekly sessions.

## **Thursday 29 Feb 2024**

**marcus_dev** 11:40
Quick update – I've confirmed the room booking for the April school holidays. The community room is available for both weeks, so we're good to go for the extra sessions. I'll update the roster spreadsheet with the dates.

**jordan_tech** 11:45
Sweet. Do we know how many kids we're expecting? I want to make sure we have enough laptops for the coding sessions.

I can update the social media posts and the website events page once the dates are confirmed. Just send me the details and I'll get on it.

**aisha_ops** 09:30

Good to know. We might be able to use that for the staffing side of things too – could be a good way to get some extra help during the busy period.

Looks fine to me. I've got the Tuesday session for the Digital Literacy pilot – that's still going ahead, right? I know we're wrapping up soon.

Not that I know of – the events team might have something but I don't think we're involved. I'll double check with them though.
